provenance.note: An independent re-measurement of the merged Atomizer coverage campaign on origin/main at d7b18d05, taken in an isolated worktree with the shared verification slot and a private clone of the pinned SBML Test Suite revision cf38585fac5de8e0e90112febb62851ee2181816. The Official SBML Test Suite measured 1758 passed / 165 unsupported / 0 failed / 0 timeout on conversion and 1663 passed / 204 unsupported / 56 failed / 0 timeout against the official reference; the 56 failures are the families PR #337 made comparable, not zero. The curated BioModels corpus measured 948 passed / 129 unsupported / 7 failed / 12 timeout in flat mode and 935 passed / 129 unsupported / 7 failed / 25 timeout in atomized mode, corrected by a serial re-measurement of every record whose verdict differed from the baseline; the campaign's earlier 'unchanged' claim was an aggregate that hid two reproducible regressions (BIOMD0000000638, BIOMD0000000954), which are now visible as failed in the corpus expectation manifest and fixed in PR #352. The corpus timeout bucket is load-dependent, so every record whose verdict differed from the baseline was re-measured one worker at a time.
